candidate.definition_en: To divide by passing or lying across; to cross each other.
candidate.explanation_ar: لما خطين أو طريقين يقطعوا بعض ويتقابلوا في نقطة واحدة.

senses.definition_en: To cross each other or meet at a point (of lines, paths, or surfaces).
senses.definition_ar: يتقاطع؛ يمر خط أو طريق عبر آخر ويلتقيان في نقطة
examples: Two roads intersect near my house.
The two circles intersect at two points.

senses.definition_en: To overlap or have common ground in ideas, interests, or fields.
senses.definition_ar: يتلاقى أو يتداخل في مجالات أو اهتمامات مشتركة
examples: Our interests intersect in the field of technology.
Two roads intersect near my house.
The two circles intersect at two points.
Our interests intersect in the field of technology.
candidate.mnemonic: فيها 'Section' 'قسم'.. الـ 'Intersect' بيقسم الطريق نصين وهو بيعدي عليه.
